originalRequest: Mission rehearsal presets feature. From the title screen the player saves named mission/seed presets, lists, edits/renames, deletes one with explicit UI confirmation, and launches that exact mission/seed into the existing real tactical game. Persist through the HTTP API into a file-backed SQLite database (localStorage alone insufficient). New versioned API under /api/presets: create/list/update/delete with server validation, parameterized SQLite, optimistic concurrency (revision), stable server-generated IDs. Name trimmed 1..40 chars, duplicate trimmed names ->409 without overwrite. Mission indices 0..2, seed integer 0..4294967295 inclusive; seed 0 must reach the real game unchanged. Malformed JSON/types/out-of-range/malformed IDs ->400; unknown valid IDs ->404; stale revision ->409 no lost update; genuine storage failure ->500. Invalid writes leave DB unchanged. Idempotent schema init preserving existing leaderboard rows. Existing campaign, saves, leaderboard, AI preview and ?mode=replay intact; shared sim/PRNG/combat unchanged. UI has loading/empty/validation/conflict/backend-failure/success states, preserves form input on failure with retry/reload, accessible, renders names as text, selection/late-fetch must not apply to another preset, confirm-delete cancel nondestructive, two independent pages demonstrate stale conflict + recovery. Launch consumes server-returned mission/seed into the existing GameCanvas/TacticalGame, not a fake shim/new simulator; editing a preset must not overwrite existing campaign saves.
